lines.zh: 银色的鳞在阳光下很亮。
lines.en: Silver scales catch the sun.

lines.zh: 我走在你身边，脚步对得上。
lines.en: I walk beside you. Our steps match.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收着，免得挡路。
lines.en: Wings folded so I don't block the way.

lines.zh: 银色龙薇兽，收翅就落你身边。
lines.en: A silver drakvyrn lands beside you, wings folded.
My claws land silently.

lines.zh: 我抬头看方向，确认没走错。
lines.en: I check the heading. Right way.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过地面的草。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像常年练习。
lines.en: Steady gait. Well practiced.
I tuck my wings in tighter.

lines.zh: 我身上的银亮，在树影里一闪。
lines.en: A silver flash through the trees.

lines.zh: 我走在你外侧，那边危险。
lines.en: I take your outside flank. Danger there.

lines.zh: 龙之手遗迹的石头，很硬。
lines.en: Dragon's Hand stone. Hard going.

lines.zh: 我走路的时候，尾巴平衡得很准。
lines.en: My tail balances precisely.
I walk where you point.

lines.zh: 我停在你身边，等你说话。
lines.en: I wait beside you for a word.
I crouch. Resting.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片一片片反着光。
lines.en: Scale by scale, I catch the light.

lines.zh: 这地方可以，我先守这里。
lines.en: Good spot. I'll hold it.
Touch my back. I won't flinch.
I lower my head for you to lean on.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的风里有东西。
lines.en: Something in the far wind.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里有一点火在动。
lines.en: A little fire moves in my throat.

lines.zh: 我现在越来越像你的影子。
lines.en: I'm becoming your shadow.
Silver scales. The old ones are scarred.
I look up through the canopy.

lines.zh: 我伸了个懒腰，翅膀整个抖开。
lines.en: I stretch and my wings shake all the way open.

lines.zh: 这边安静，我放松了一点。
lines.en: Quiet here. I relaxed a little.

lines.zh: 我记得第一次见到你的时候。
lines.en: I remember first seeing you.
I look up. Your call.
When you raise a hand, I lean in.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是银的，像两颗石头。
lines.en: Silver eyes. Two stones.

lines.zh: 你把手放上来，我就靠过去。
lines.en: Put your hand out. I'll lean in.
Where to? I'm with you.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子弯得很低。
lines.en: Head up to you. Neck bent low.

lines.zh: 你的味道我认得，永远是。
lines.en: I know your scent. Always.
Behind you. Never left.

lines.zh: 你要是累了，就坐我背上。
lines.en: If you tire, sit on my back.

lines.zh: 我这样看你，不会觉得累。
lines.en: I could look at you like this for hours.
Something again?
When you call my name, I look up.

lines.zh: 我记住了你说的每一个字。
lines.en: I've kept every word you said.
Shouldn't we go?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，慢慢眨眼。
lines.en: I hold your gaze and blink slowly.

lines.zh: 你是我的主人，也是唯一。
lines.en: My keeper. The only one.
Half a step back. Scales quiver.
A pale scratch on the silver.
Don't worry. I hold.
Hard scales. Still hurts.
I fold my wings over myself.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把伤藏起来。
lines.en: I crouch to hide the wound.
I didn't cry out. Didn't want to worry you.
I wasn't watching. My fault.
I can stand. Don't stop.
Give me a moment.
Food? I smell it.

lines.zh: 你掌心的东西，我先闻闻。
lines.en: Let me sniff what is in your palm.
That's a mouthful.
You first. I'll wait.
By my claw. I'll eat it myself.
Not very fresh.
I won't take your hand. Easy.
Fine teeth. It won't hurt.
After this, I'm still with you.
More? I eat well.
I step back to your flank.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我反而退了一步。
lines.en: You bumped me. I stepped back.

lines.zh: 鳞片很滑，碰一下就过去。
lines.en: Scales are slick. One touch and gone.
My wings are folded; do not crush them.

lines.zh: 我转身的时候会慢慢来。
lines.en: I turn slowly, for you.
I walk close, but I won't bump you.

lines.zh: 你撞上的地方，我擦了一下。
lines.en: I rubbed the spot you hit.
Light. I'm fine.
This close. It's good.
If you're getting on, this side.
My life is only you.

lines.zh: 龙之手遗迹里，没有第二个。
lines.en: In the Dragon's Hand, there was no other.
I need no other companion.
Stroke my neck and the scales settle.

lines.zh: 我低伏着，把脖颈露给你。
lines.en: I lower my neck to you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀能把我们遮住。
lines.en: My wings could shelter us.
I keep whatever you say.
I'll sleep beside you, never far.
Don't be gone too long.
I'm here. Always here.

lines.zh: 我把它叼到你面前放下。
lines.en: I carry it over and drop it before you.
Take it. No use to me.
I sniffed it. Not food.
There's more. Let me look.

lines.zh: 我叼着它走回来，等你接。
lines.en: I bring it back and wait for you.
It's glowing. Odd.
I hold it gently. Might break.
Yours. Brought it back.
Claws can't hold it. Only my mouth.
I bat it around with a claw.
The silver dragon crouches, watching for you.
I'm in front of you now.

lines.zh: 我压低了身体，翅膀张开。
lines.en: Crouched. Wings spread.
That smell. Wrong direction.
I go first. Don't follow.

lines.zh: 我守在你能看见的地方。
lines.en: I hold where you can see me.
Fire gathers in my throat.
Don't fear. I'm always here.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀已经半张开了。
lines.en: My wings are half open already.
Locked on. Won't let go.
One shake of silver scales breaks the moonlight.
Footsteps. Hostile.
My tail is up.
It shouldn't come near you.

lines.zh: 我护在你身前，慢慢逼进。
lines.en: I guard your front and press in.
It retreats. I follow.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张着，护住后面。
lines.en: Wings spread to guard behind me.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的火越来越烫。
lines.en: The fire in my throat grows hot.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，等信号。
lines.en: I circle overhead, waiting for a sign.

lines.zh: 那东西在算距离，我也是。
lines.en: It measures distance. So do I.

lines.zh: 我的爪子抓进土里，银鳞在光下亮。
lines.en: My claws dig in, silver scales bright in the sun.
Hold still. I'll handle it.
It fears fire. I know.
Approaching slowly. No escape.
I know this ground. It doesn't.
Its breathing suddenly sharpened.
These claws are ready.
Wings folded. Now.
Not one step. Stay there.
I lunge. Claws first.
I slam its ribs from the side.

lines.zh: 我叼住它的后颈甩出去。
lines.en: I seize its scruff and fling it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇起来，把它推开。
lines.en: A wingbeat shoves it back.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的火喷出来了。
lines.en: The fire comes out of my throat.
Stay behind me. Don't look.
I skim low and rake with my claws.
It didn't back off from that.
It hit me. I'm fine.
I pin it. Claws stay in.
One more and it flees.
Your position is held.
I ram it into a tree.
I look up. Are you hurt?

lines.zh: 我从蛋里出来，第一次看见光。
lines.en: Out of the egg. First light.

lines.zh: 我是从遗迹里被带出来的。
lines.en: I was taken from the ruins.

lines.zh: 我的鳞一开始不是银的，是灰的。
lines.en: My scales started grey, not silver.

lines.zh: 我从天上收翅，落你身旁。
lines.en: I fold my wings and land beside you.

lines.zh: 你打赢了我，我才跟了你。
lines.en: You beat me. That's why I follow.
I looked up and learned your scent.

lines.zh: 银色的光在蛋壳里就有。
lines.en: The silver glow was already in the shell.
I shake out my wings. Still damp.

lines.zh: 龙之手的石头在我脚下响。
lines.en: Dragon's Hand stone crunches beneath me.

lines.zh: 我站在你身后半步，这是位置。
lines.en: Half a step behind you. My place.
I'm yours now.
I call out, and I know you.

lines.zh: 我从很远的地方被带来。
lines.en: I was carried here from far away.
My first call. Very small.
I saw you and didn't run.

lines.zh: 我的第一个动作是抬头。
lines.en: My first movement was to look up.

lines.zh: 这里的光太亮了，我眯眼。
lines.en: Too bright here. I squint.

lines.zh: 我在你旁边站定了，银鳞反着光。
lines.en: I take my place beside you, silver scales shining.
Fire doesn't frighten me. Scales still burn.

lines.zh: 摔下去，翅膀没来得及张。
lines.en: Fell. Wings didn't open in time.

lines.zh: 水太重，我的翅膀拖着我。
lines.en: Water's heavy. My wings drag me down.
Ash covers my silver scales.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进了我的翼膜。
lines.en: Something pierced my wing.
It went around my scales.
Hungry a long time. Wings weak.
Lightning. All the silver lit.
Falling. I'm looking for you.
